review_method.source_access: Only helper --help read; no game source/tests/docs/prior reviews/recordings/internal state/target metadata inspected
review_method.interaction: Visible selectors and geometry only; each screenshot viewed in a separate call before adaptive input. No keyboard/mouse/evaluation. No alternate URL. No checkpoint retries or third attempt. Map visibly closed.
review_method.boundaries: Inspected timings and screenshots; requested 3000ms waits commonly shortened to roughly 2980ms and FIRE 1200ms waits to remaining budget. Did not bypass boundaries. Captures pause and clear all contacts and AIM; live zoom capture does not imply zoom survives resume.
review_method.build_identity: BUILD 109 visible on title. Frozen SHA supplied by requester, not independently inspected or verified.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed/playable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable rough edges; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional across assessed scope. Holistic judgments from observed interaction, not computed from wins, scores or completion rate.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, completable touch mission with strong atmosphere and useful guidance; targeting clarity and crowded small-screen feedback temper the experience. Two assisted wins do not certify manual control quality.
reasons.controls: MOVE, scene swipe, FIRE drag, AIM, DASH and JUMP responded in brief samples. Tap aim and two-contact route/fire made progress possible. Moving targets and armor/cover shots were hard to diagnose precisely; airborne route activation required retry. Sustained manual combat unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, exposed-coil timing and uplink survival formed a clear short progression. Shield loss added pressure. Much travel used route assists, so depth, challenge balance and continuous enjoyment remain uncertain.
reasons.presentation: Consistent cyan/amber visual language, rain, reflective surfaces, industrial silhouettes and weapon/coil feedback created a cohesive mood. Audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Visible handbook, planning map, named receivers, changing hold prompts, SAVED/OFF states, upload percent and START FRESH supported completion. Reload trigger and airborne route behavior needed learning.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and main prompts were readable at 844x390. Distant enemies, small world labels, thin route marks and stacked banners/threat/interaction overlays demanded inspection; handbook lower content was clipped with scrolling indicated.

unassessed: Continuous unpaused enjoyment and reaction time
Tools and weapons beyond coil rifle
